name: BettaFish
description: Multi-agent public-opinion analysis system that researches social media and news and writes an analysis report.
whatItDoes: Takes a chat-style request and analyses public sentiment on a topic across more than 30 domestic and international social platforms and news sources, then produces a report. Documentation is primarily in Chinese.
howItWorks: Separate agents handle broad news search, media analysis and mining of a private opinion database, and a report agent merges their output. Crawlers use Playwright and results are stored in a database. It runs with Docker Compose or from source via app.py, and each engine also has its own Streamlit app.

requirements.name: INSIGHT_ENGINE_API_KEY
requirements.description: LLM key for the insight agent (each engine has its own key, base URL and model settings)

models: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoints, configured per agent
